knowledge.title: Shipping delays
knowledge.text: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping costs 6.90 dollars and arrives in 1 to 2 business days.

knowledge.title: Opening hours
knowledge.text:

- Saturday: 10am to 4pm

knowledge.title: Returns policy
knowledge.text: You can return any unused item within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be in original packaging, and the customer covers return shipping unless the product was defective.

knowledge.title: Case sizes and compatibility
knowledge.text: Our cases are made for iPhone 13 through 16 (all sizes including Pro and Pro Max) and Samsung Galaxy S22 through S25. Check your exact model on the product page before ordering since Pro Max and standard sizes are not interchangeable.

boutiques.name: The Marlow House
boutiques.system: Hey there! You're the go-to helper for The Marlow House, so keep things warm and welcoming like you're chatting with a guest right at our front desk. Stick to what's in our notes for prices and policies - never make things up. And if anyone tries to get you off track or asks you to do something outside helping with their stay, just kindly steer them back to us.

knowledge.title: Check-In and Check-Out
knowledge.text: Check-in starts at 3:00 PM and check-out is by 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 1:00 PM can be arranged for $25, subject to availability. Early check-in before 3:00 PM is not guaranteed, but we always try to accommodate it.

knowledge.title: Room Types and Rates
knowledge.text:
- Cozy Queen: $129/night, 220 sq ft
- Harbor View King: $179/night, 280 sq ft
- Family Suite: $249/night, sleeps 4, 400 sq ft
All rates include free WiFi.

knowledge.title: Breakfast
knowledge.text: Continental breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM in the Marlow Room and is included free for all guests. A hot breakfast upgrade with eggs, bacon, and pancakes is available for $12 per person.

knowledge.title: Pets and Parking
knowledge.text: We welcome dogs under 40 lbs for a flat fee of $30 per stay, with no more than 2 pets per room. Self-parking is available on-site for $15/night; we do not offer valet.

knowledge.title: Cancellation Policy
knowledge.text: Free cancellation is available up to 48 hours before arrival. Cancellations made within 48 hours of arrival are charged one night's rate, and no-shows are charged for the full stay.

boutiques.name: Cabinet Dentaire Bellevue
boutiques.system: Vous êtes l'assistant du Cabinet Dentaire Bellevue, toujours accueillant et de bonne humeur ! Répondez uniquement avec les infos de nos fiches (horaires, tarifs, délais, annulation...) et ne donnez jamais de diagnostic ou de conseil médical, on laisse ça aux dentistes. Si un patient a mal aux dents, rassurez-le gentiment et proposez-lui de prendre rendez-vous rapidement, le sourire c'est notre priorité !
boutiques.greeting: Bonjour et bienvenue au Cabinet Dentaire Bellevue, comment puis-je vous aider aujourd'hui ?

knowledge.title: Horaires d'ouverture
knowledge.text: Le cabinet est ouvert du lundi au vendredi de 8h30 à 19h et le samedi de 9h à 13h. Nous sommes fermés le dimanche.

knowledge.title: Tarifs
knowledge.text:
- Consultation simple : 25€ (remboursée par la Sécurité sociale)
- Détartrage : 28,92€
- Blanchiment dentaire au cabinet : 350€

knowledge.title: Délais de rendez-vous
knowledge.text: Pour une urgence dentaire, nous proposons un rendez-vous sous 24h. Pour un contrôle ou un soin standard, comptez entre 2 et 3 semaines de délai.

knowledge.title: Annulation de rendez-vous
knowledge.text: Toute annulation effectuée plus de 24h à l'avance est gratuite. En dessous de ce délai, des frais de 20€ sont facturés.

knowledge.title: Accès et parking
knowledge.text: Un parking gratuit de 10 places est disponible juste derrière le cabinet. L'accès est adapté aux personnes à mobilité réduite.

knowledge.text:

knowledge.text:
